text: Move 'Clear checked' out of the list screen into list properties (too easy to hit accidentally)

Web: removed the clear-checked button + handler from ListPage; added a red 'Clear checked (N)' card section to ListPropsPage between Category order and Notes (only shown when >0). Android: removed the button + undo snackbar from ListScreen/ListViewModel; added a live checkedCount + clearChecked() to ListPropsViewModel and a red TextButton to ListPropsScreen in the same spot (no undo — the deliberate trip into properties is the safeguard, and cleared items go to backlog). Moved/rewrote the affected tests on both platforms.
